card.name: Punctuation in needle withdrawal steps
card.fires_on: Colons, periods, commas and 'and' in injection instructions, right after a step number or needle mention and just before the instruction to withdraw the needle or activate the safety shield.

modes.label: Step number punctuation
modes.description: The colon or period right after a step number in injection instructions.
modes.example: Inject slowly (5–7 seconds) Step 4<<:>> Remove the Needle and Activate the Safety Shield

modes.label: Linking word after needle
modes.description: A comma or 'and' joining needle with syringe or safety device actions.
modes.example: Once the entire dose has been injected<<,>> the needle safety device will be triggered,
